description:
Phase 5. Olivine idle spin-down ports from phase-a (opt-in idle_timeout worker param, client-reads-only activity, snapshot-before-spin-down, {:shutdown, :idle} exit, foreman self-removal). Distributor: idle DOWN -> placeholder entry committed, NO eager re-recruit; revival on demand. Re-adoption residue only: the durable materializers/ family already feeds bootstrap re-adoption, so the distributor re-adopts only tags bootstrap left ABSENT (one-shot per sweep, pending-demand reservation, never remove a pre-existing worker).

NOTE for the idle path: {:shutdown, :idle} arrives at the distributor's assignment monitor as a plain DOWN — the healing handler (q67.21.4b) heals ALL non-:noconnection reasons eagerly, so idle spin-down must either be distinguished by reason ({:shutdown, :idle} -> placeholder entry, no recruit, no backoff) or the worker must be deregistered from monitoring before it exits. Decide when porting.

RESIDUALS inherited from bedrock-q67.21.4 (audits of PRs #190/#191):
- N2: emit a covered-before-caught-up telemetry breadcrumb — a freshly recruited materializer is published as covered while still drinking its stream suffix; observability should distinguish covered-and-current from covered-and-catching-up.
- Placeholder fit: for repo traffic the placeholder park is ~50ms per attempt (the builder's fetch timeout) with the repo backoff loop doing the actual waiting. Consider a hold-aware fetch timeout for known-placeholder routes, or accept retry-loop smoothing as-is; decide with measurements, not speculatively.
title: Idle spin-down + re-adoption residue
